intent: Make the npm tarball a stable, self-contained installation unit with future skill/plugin release roots, isolated package inspection, private-prefix production installation, and explicit XML-only behavior when Chrome is unavailable.

findings.title: Exact size snapshot blocks legitimate artifact additions
findings.fix: Removed the exact README byte-count gate while retaining npm pack file-contract inspection.

findings.title: Successful startup did not prove private-prefix resolution
findings.fix: Asserted every direct production dependency exists under the empty prefix and the installed bin resolves into the installed package.

applied_fixes: Decoupled the artifact contract from a dated documentation size snapshot.
Added direct production-dependency and installed-bin containment checks.
advisory_outputs: The canonical skill and client plugin manifests are intentionally created by sibling beads; this package contract reserves and validates their release paths when they appear.

learnings.note: No docs/solutions knowledge base or critical-patterns file was present in this repository.
